name: Custom Touchpad Gestures (blank)
description: Personal touchpad gesture set: 3-finger up/down (overview/minimize), 3-finger left/right (tile, per-app overrides for Brave/Dolphin), 3-finger pinch (Dolphin split view), 4-finger up/down (fullscreen or maximize/quit), 4-finger left/right (workspace switch). Also handles Brave-opens-in-new-workspace and workspace compaction. Fully self-contained, no dependency on any other touchpad gesture extension.
